silhouette: Dome-shaped top with a vertical hanging line ending in a distinct hook at the bottom
viewpoint: three-quarter view from a slightly elevated angle

parts.name: canopy
parts.shape: hemispherical scalloped dome with curved triangular green fabric panels
parts.connection: stitched along its seams to the tips of the supporting ribs

parts.name: supporting ribs
parts.shape: radiating thin linear struts curving inward along the underside of the canopy
parts.connection: hinged to the upper runner near the shaft and fitted into pocket tips on the canopy

parts.name: central shaft
parts.shape: long straight rigid vertical cylinder passing through the center of the canopy
parts.connection: fixed firmly through the apex of the canopy and joined to the top runner

parts.name: hooked handle
parts.shape: J-shaped curved cylindrical grip at the base
parts.connection: attached securely to the bottom end of the central shaft

recognitionCues: distinct curved green dome shape of the fabric canopy
visible structural ribs radiating symmetrically from the center
characteristic J-shaped hooked handle at the base
avoid: banana anatomy or tapering yellow flaps
